@saltfishinthecity is one of those spots where you are guaranteed to have a good and fun night out! 

The setup is counter-style with very laid-back, cool energy. DJ sets playing groovy music, sake as the drink of choice, and a strong attention to detail throughout — branded chopstick holders, staff T-shirts, and a space that feels curated without trying too hard.

They serve only 20 burgers 🍔 per day, which means booking in advance and pre-ordering the burger is a must. The place is almost always full, especially on the weekends!

What we ate:
– Oysters (5$) cheese & cold cuts (12$) ocould be a nice option to start with 
– Hand rolls (salmon / ikura — you choose) 9$ each, not bad 
– Shrimp tabbouleh (18$) it was amazing 
– Octopus (9$) & calamari (11$)4) the octopus skewers were so good 
- Torched salmon nigiri (10$) for 2 pcs amazingly fresh 
– Cheeseburger with black Angus patty(21$) one of the most memorable burgers in town 
- Fish caviar burger (23$) top selling item, the taste it amazing but its a but heavy for me because its fried 
– Finished with chocolate mousse & debes tahini (12$) loved the tahini one! 

🍶 I suggest to pair your experience with sake
